description: Get autocomplete-style keyword suggestions for seeds, with volume and CPC.

limit.description: Maximum number of rows to return (1-50, default 10). Each returned row is charged, so this caps the cost of one call.

where.description: JSON filter expression (see the Ahrefs filter syntax docs). Filterable fields: keyword, volume, cpc.

keywords.description: Keywords to analyze (up to 100). Each returned keyword is one charged row.

order_by.description: Sort order: 'field' or 'field:desc', comma-separated. Sortable fields: keyword, volume, cpc.

pricing.note: Billed per call from metered usage; the reference price is typical.

# Ahrefs Keywords Explorer Search Suggestions

Get autocomplete-style keyword suggestions for seeds, with volume and CPC.

## Pricing

- Inspect reference unit price: $0.00774 USD per result.
- Final settlement uses the provider-reported actual cost after strict validation; the reference price is not used to infer the final charge.
